urlText: Train services to experience significant delays
content:
Sydney Trains advises passengers that on Monday, 9 December, there will be major service reductions and cancellations on the heavy rail network due to the impact of recent industrial action.

This action will significantly disrupt passengers on Monday, particularly those travelling on Intercity services.

Many inner Sydney suburban passengers will see a reduction in service, with delays and cancellations throughout the day on the T1 North Shore and Western, T2 Leppington & Inner West, T3 Liverpool and Inner West and T8 Airport & South lines.
 
Services on the T6 Lidcombe & Bankstown Line will be replaced by buses between Bankstown and Lidcombe.

Passengers using the Blue Mountains and South Coast lines will have one train per hour travelling in each direction, while those using the Central Coast & Newcastle line are scheduled to have two trains per hour travelling in each direction.

Passengers on Intercity services should plan ahead and look for alternative modes of transport where possible, in particular, for students travelling to school.

Sydney Trains apologises to our passengers for the disruption, and thanks commuters for their understanding as staff work to minimise the impacts of the difficult industrial period.

Plan ahead and check the latest updates before travelling. Allow extra travel time and see the news story for further information.

urlText: Greenwich Point Wharf closed

Monday 22 April until 13 December 2024
 
Greenwich Point Wharf is being upgraded and will be closed to the public for around eight months, weather and site conditions permitting. Ferry passengers will need to use alternative transport during the wharf closure:

  • Additional bus services for the 265 route will be provided between Greenwich Point Wharf and Crows Nest, via St Leonards during weekdays and nights and over the weekends to offset the missing ferry services.
  • Captain Cook Cruises operates a commuter ferry service during peak travel times from Greenwich Wharf Bay Street. Please check their website for more information.
  • Allow extra travel time, listen to announcements and check information displays for service updates.
  • For more information on the Greenwich Point Wharf Upgrade please visit the Greenwich Point Wharf Upgrade page.

  • The 230 bus service from Military Road can also be used to connect to North Sydney and other destinations.
  • Allow extra travel time, listen to announcements, and check information displays for service updates.

urlText: Port Macquarie bus service changes
content:
From Tuesday 3 December 2024, a temporary shuttle bus service will connect passengers to Route 322 bus services as planned roadworks commence near Lighthouse Plaza Shopping Centre.
 
Emerald Drive at Ocean Drive will re-open, and Matthew Flinders Drive at Ocean Drive will close from 3 December until the end of February.
 
The changes will impact several bus routes and school services in the area.
 
Routes affected:
  • 322 - Lighthouse Plaza to Port Macquarie via Shelly Beach
  • 323 - Port Macquarie to Lighthouse Beach (Loop Service)
  • 333 - Kendall to Port Macquarie via Bonny Hills
  • 334 - Lighthouse Plaza to Port Macquarie
Route 322 will run from the bus stop at Pacific Drive after Waterview Close (Stop ID: 2444262) connecting with a free shuttle service to allow passengers to travel to/from Lighthouse Plaza.
 
Shuttle service will run to and from temporary stop at Matthew Flinders Drive and eastern end of Kelvin Grove via Matthew Flinders Drive, Bangalay Road, Pacific Drive and Ocean Drive to Lighthouse Plaza.
 
Missed stop: Ocean Dr at Matthew Flinders Dr (Stop ID: 2444201)
Nearest alternative stop: Lighthouse Plaza, Emerald Dr (Stop ID: 244468)

Service changes
  • Route 322 will start and finish at temporary stop in Matthew Flinders Drive at Kelvin Grove.
  • Route 323 will be temporarily discontinued and replaced by routes 322 and 324.
  • Route 333 to Laurieton will divert from Ocean Drive to Emerald Drive, Lighthouse Plaza due to temporary closure of bus stop (Ocean Drive at Matthew Flinders Drive).
  • Route 334 to set down at Lighthouse Plaza, Emerald Drive due to temporary closure of bus stop (Ocean Drive at Matthew Flinders Drive).
School services affected
  • School routes S443, S444, S445, S458, S462, S522, S554, S559, S562, S566, S567, S586, S590, S595 and S597 will also be adjusted.

Plan your trip for real-time up-to-date information.
